published_prior_art.cite: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates gives the covariance-dependent network-basis objective and AronowGreenLee2014SharpVariance gives the scalar Fréchet endpoints; the affine endpoint reduction is their direct but useful synthesis.
Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates, Assumption 2†, supplies supplied-basis nondegeneracy; compact projective normalization is a routine supporting reduction.
Reeves1975GlobalQuadratic and AdjimanDallwigFloudasNeumaier1998AlphaBB give generic certification machinery, not an exact-boundary projective certificate for Zhao's two-endpoint maximin objective.
Bergin1999RestrictedMarginals supplies the continuity machinery; the Zhao-specific full-correspondence strict-dominance implication is a specialized maximum-theorem consequence.
Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates uses a zero-covariance surrogate but does not provide a nondegenerate, full-optimizer-correspondence certificate separating it from the Fréchet-robust rule.

MikhaeilGreen2024SharpRegressionAdjustment proves scalar sharp-bound plug-in consistency, not uniform convergence and argmax-correspondence consistency for this nonconvex projective network-basis criterion.
Standard uniform argmax theory gives point convergence under isolated uniqueness; the tie counterexample is a useful boundary result rather than a separate literature frontier.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Relative-open strict-dominance claim
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Strict robust-versus-zero-surrogate dominance is conditional on a separate exact witness that certifies positive full-correspondence separation and optimizer-wide kappa slack.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: A relative-open dominance region is asserted only conditional on a positive output of oeq:separated-lawful-witness; no universal strict-improvement claim is made.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source imposes supplied-basis boundedness and nondegeneracy, defines the covariance-dependent nonconvex network-basis optimization, uses independent potential-outcome pairs ex ante, supplies a one-half approximation plus local search, and identifies robust basis choice under misspecified moments as future work.
Lemma 1 gives sharp fixed-marginal covariance bounds attained by comonotone and countermonotone quantile couplings.
Proposition 1 establishes consistency of sharp regression-adjusted variance-bound plug-ins under outcome-model consistency and uniform square-integrability conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Economic Theory 13(2) (1999), 471–481; journal theorem text publicly inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible record reports continuity of the restricted-marginal correspondence, continuous optimal values, and upper-hemicontinuity of optimizer correspondences; no unverified theorem-level claim is used against the proposal.
The paper gives branch-and-bound for bounded all-quadratic programs and demonstrates finite epsilon-global termination.

The alphaBB method builds rigorous convex lower bounds using interval-Hessian information and guarantees convergence arbitrarily close to the global optimum for twice-differentiable constrained programs.
The paper studies generic distributionally robust optimization with uncertain linear or rank dependence and tractable reformulations, not causal control-variate basis choice.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association, online 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper optimizes conservative quadratic variance bounds under interference and complex designs, a different decision object from a control-variate basis.
The paper supplies the randomization-based known-exposure-mapping framework, inverse-probability weighting, and interference-aware variance analysis used as design background here.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a direct theorem or counterexample clarifying when maximin endpoint gain r(B) agrees with minimax residual loss w(B); otherwise consistently describe the decision as maximin-gain rather than variance-minimax.
After solving the certified witness OEQ, report a worked three-vertex certificate with exact Pi, Omega, endpoint values, full optimizer-set bounds, delta, eta, and the resulting open neighborhood.
Make the plug-in theorem more practically distinctive by adding a finite-pilot uniform deviation bound for the robust value or an implementable confidence rule for selecting among near-optimal bases.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the robust reduction, certified global-solver OEQ, and pilot argmax-consistency chain; keep strict dominance explicitly witness-gated.
